messages:
sam: Quick sync — I rolled up a 7d view of prefix-cache hit rate by model / route / customer cohort. Seeing a ~22% drop in hit rate for gpt-12b on /chat/stream for a single large customer (AcmeInc) starting 2026-03-08. Query + dashboard link below. Can folks triage? :eyes:
elaine: Link? can you post the grafana panel + the raw SQL you used?
sam: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/pmXy/prefix-cache-rollups (view-only)
sam: SQL excerpt:
```
SELECT model, route, customer_id, sum(tokens_saved) as tokens_saved, avg(hit_rate) as hit_rate, count(*) as requests
FROM prefix_cache_rollup
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY model, route, customer_id
ORDER BY tokens_saved DESC
LIMIT 250;
```
raj: I eyeballed the raw traces for AcmeInc — their stream requests started including an extra header `x-request-origin` after the 2026-03-08 deploy. If our cache key includes all headers for stream routes we may be fragmenting keys.
tyler: yikes. which deploy changed header wiring? perf-bot noted a small SDK change merged on 2026-03-08 (PR 482).
perf-bot: deploy 2026-03-08T02:14Z: merged PR #482 — SDK: include request metadata in streaming payload.
elaine: That matches. If the header is ephemeral per-client we get many unique prefixes and hit_rate collapses. Is the keying code using `stringify(request)` anywhere?
raj: yes in hot path: `cacheKey = sha256(prefix + JSON.stringify(req.metadata))` — I flagged this previously for non-stream but it crept into streaming handler.
sam: Repro steps: I replayed a small sample with and without the header; hit_rate for a fixed prompt goes from 46% -> 3% when header is present. I can file a patch to normalize keying (strip ephemeral headers) + add a migration to backfill canonical keys for last 48h.
tyler: For short-term mitigation we should: 1) patch keying to ignore `x-request-origin` and other ephemeral fields, 2) add a warmup job to touch top prefixes for affected customers after the patch, 3) add an alert for hit rate regressions.
elaine: Agree. Suggest alert: when avg(hit_rate) for top-10 routes drops by >10 percentage points for 30m AND tokens_saved loss > 50k in that window.
sam: Filed ENGRT-632 with the three action items, assigning me and raj. /cc @oncall
raj: Working on a small PR to change keying: will only include `client_id`, `model`, `route`, and sanitized prompt prefix. Exclude all `x-*` headers. Will add unit tests with traced examples.
perf-bot: Metric backfill started for prefix_cache_rollup (job id: backfill-1932). ETA ~ 18m.
elaine: Also let's add a dashboard tile showing eviction_rate and unique_prefix_count per-customer — the correlation is strong in this incident.
tyler: Once PR is up we should canary to dedicated region for AcmeInc traffic only (small window) then roll global. Add a warmup task that issues `touch_prefix` RPCs for the top 100 prefixes by tokens_saved.
sam: Will include a small script in the PR that emits warmup traces and a promcounter for warmup_success.
oncall: I put a short 1hr paging policy for this incident — oncall to monitor hit_rate alert and rollback if warmup doesn't recover hit_rate by >8% in 45m.
raj: Note: we should also verify KV-cache TTL changes — config `kv.prefetch_ttl` was lowered in the same deploy from 12h -> 1h for testing. That would make warmup more urgent.
sam: Good catch. I've set kv.prefetch_ttl back to 12h in a staged config while we fix keying.
elaine: Recap action items: (1) PR to sanitize keying (raj), (2) warmup job + script (sam), (3) alert + dashboard tile (elaine), (4) short TTL rollback applied (sam), (5) canary plan for AcmeInc (tyler).
sam: I'll post PR link and timeline here when ready. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
perf-bot: PR #491 opened: sanitize cache key + tests (owner: raj). Backfill complete. Metrics show hit_rate recovering to ~43% for AcmeInc as of now.
sam: Closing loop — after canary and warmup we saw tokens_saved for AcmeInc return to previous baseline. Will schedule a follow-up to harden keying and expand warmup to top n customers.
